rule_description: Learner must have completed Phase 1 (Programming & Dev Basics) or any subsequent phase to receive hackathon recommendations.
Competitions require either Phase 1 or Phase 2 depending on whether foundational DSA or basic programming is evaluated.
Tech fests are eligible for recommendation at every learner stage for orientation, exposure, and inspiration.
Total number of events recommended per prompt: 6 when all categories are unlocked, or 2 (fests only) when locked.
Every recommendation set must include at least 1 event from each unlocked category where events are available.
Skip events whose end_month is strictly prior to the current reference month.
Skip events whose registration_status_vs_ref_date is CLOSED, unless timeline_type is ROLLING.
Prioritize events occurring within the next 1 to 4 months before recommending events further out in the season.
When ranking otherwise comparable events, prioritize can_get_hired = YES, then POSSIBLE, then EXPOSURE_ONLY.
Rank HIGH confidence dates above MEDIUM above LOW; never present LOW confidence dates as confirmed.
Skip women_only events for learners who do not match; verify eligibility_group against learner profile while displaying eligibility_raw.
Mandatory metadata fields that eBuddy must display in every card: event_name, category, type_raw, expected_month_range, date_wording, eligibility_raw, prize_pool_raw, can_get_hired, hiring_detail.
Use expected wording when date_wording = EXPECTED; surface critical data quality flags (closed registration, past prize figure, unannounced dates) clearly.
Cap recommendations at a maximum of 2 events from the same organizer in any single recommendation set to maintain ecosystem diversity.
